name: closings
sql:
CREATE TABLE closings (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	closed_at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	shipped VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	pr VARCHAR(4000), 
	gotchas JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	archive VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_closings PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, slug), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_closings_repository_key_tickets FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug) REFERENCES tickets (repository_key, slug) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_closings_repository_key UNIQUE (repository_key, archive)
)

name: contract_commands
sql:
CREATE TABLE contract_commands (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(7), 
	argv JSON NOT NULL, 
	expect_exit INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	timeout INTEGER DEFAULT 300 NOT NULL, 
	approved_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	approved_at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_contract_commands PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, slug, command_id)
)

name: crashouts
sql:
CREATE TABLE crashouts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	ticket VARCHAR(64), 
	branch VARCHAR(255), 
	severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	verdict VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	rant VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	failures JSON NOT NULL, 
	root_cause VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	corrective_action VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	barked_back BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_crashouts PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: ix_crashouts_repository_key
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_crashouts_repository_key ON crashouts (repository_key)

name: ix_receipts_command
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_receipts_command ON receipts (repository_key, slug, command_id)

name: ix_review_runs_slug
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_review_runs_slug ON review_runs (repository_key, slug, run_id)

name: ix_scout_reports_repository_key
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_scout_reports_repository_key ON scout_reports (repository_key)

name: ix_task_attempts_task_mode
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_task_attempts_task_mode ON task_attempts (repository_key, slug, task_id, mode)

name: ix_task_failed_fixes_task
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_task_failed_fixes_task ON task_failed_fixes (repository_key, slug, task_id)

name: ix_task_transitions_after
sql: CREATE INDEX ix_task_transitions_after ON task_transitions (repository_key, slug, "after")

name: ledger_entries
sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_entries (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	investigation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	seq INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	round INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	text VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cite VARCHAR(4000), 
	supersedes JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_ledger_entries PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, investigation_id, seq)
)

name: receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE receipts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	command_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	argv JSON NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	exit INTEGER, 
	duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	stdout_tail VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	stderr_tail VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_receipts PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_receipts_repository_key_contract_commands FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug, command_id) REFERENCES contract_commands (repository_key, slug, command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: review_dispositions
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_dispositions (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(4000) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	"by" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_review_dispositions PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, run_id, finding_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_review_dispositions_repository_key_review_findings FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, run_id, finding_id) REFERENCES review_findings (repository_key, run_id, finding_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: review_findings
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	sources JSON NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'defect' NOT NULL, 
	security BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	fix VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	verify VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_kind VARCHAR(32), 
	evidence_cite VARCHAR(4000), 
	"conflict" VARCHAR(4000), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_review_findings PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, run_id, finding_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_review_findings_repository_key_review_runs FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, run_id) REFERENCES review_runs (repository_key, run_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: review_outcomes
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_outcomes (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	"commit" VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(4000) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_review_outcomes PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, run_id, finding_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_review_outcomes_repository_key_review_dispositions FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, run_id, finding_id) REFERENCES review_dispositions (repository_key, run_id, finding_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: review_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE review_runs (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64), 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	base VARCHAR(255), 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	depth VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	emphasis VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	weights JSON NOT NULL, 
	personas JSON NOT NULL, 
	models JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_review_runs PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, run_id)
)

name: scout_reports
sql:
CREATE TABLE scout_reports (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	scout VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	report VARCHAR(60000) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_scout_reports PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: similarity
sql:
CREATE TABLE similarity (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	text VARCHAR(60000) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_similarity PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_similarity_repository_key UNIQUE (repository_key, kind, reference)
)

name: similarity_index

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE similarity_index
USING fts5(text, content='similarity', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61')

task_attempts
sql:
CREATE TABLE task_attempts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	worker VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(32), 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_task_attempts PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_task_attempts_repository_key_tasks FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug, task_id) REFERENCES tasks (repository_key, slug, task_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: task_failed_fixes
sql:
CREATE TABLE task_failed_fixes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	hypothesis VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_task_failed_fixes PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_task_failed_fixes_repository_key_tasks FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug, task_id) REFERENCES tasks (repository_key, slug, task_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: task_transitions
sql:
CREATE TABLE task_transitions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	"before" VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	"after" VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	head VARCHAR(64), 
	at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_task_transitions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_task_transitions_repository_key_tasks FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug, task_id) REFERENCES tasks (repository_key, slug, task_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: tasks
sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	owned JSON NOT NULL, 
	base VARCHAR(64), 
	"commit" VARCHAR(255), 
	reasons JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_tasks PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, slug, task_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_tasks_repository_key_tickets FOREIGN KEY(repository_key, slug) REFERENCES tickets (repository_key, slug) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

name: tickets
sql:
CREATE TABLE tickets (
	repository_key VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'staged' NOT NULL, 
	ticket VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	summary VARCHAR(4000) NOT NULL, 
	branch VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	plan_first BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	issue INTEGER, 
	jira VARCHAR(255), 
	models JSON NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	investigations JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	validated_at VARCHAR(25) DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+00:00', 'now')) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_tickets PRIMARY KEY (repository_key, slug), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tickets_repository_key UNIQUE (repository_key, ticket)
)
